title: Invalid layout symbol
description: Layout-quality rule — a text object carries a {{Symbol}} that is not a Get parameter. A symbol is the value of Get(<Symbol>) at display time; an unknown one is not dropped but rendered LITERALLY in browse and preview mode, so the raw {{Text}} shows up in the layout. Validity is decided against the standard reference (function_name_lookup, chunk_role 'getparameter') over all languages it covers — FileMaker also accepts the localized parameter name, so a localized symbol is valid, not a defect. Two limits keep this a warning: the reference's localized coverage is uneven (Spanish and Portuguese Get-parameter names are absent, German only partly covered), and bracket forms such as {{Get(FoundCount)}} never enter the symbol inventory at all, so the rule is blind to them.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: An unresolvable symbol renders as its own source text. The layout shows {{FooBar}} to the user instead of a value — visible, but silent: nothing errors, nothing logs.
rule.remediation: Fix the spelling to a Get parameter FileMaker knows (the layout editor's "Other Symbol…" dialog lists them), or remove the placeholder if the value is no longer wanted.
